changelog:
COMPASS
  Synchronized Multi-Home Surround Complete

Ava devices across living room, kitchen, bedroom, study become one coherent sound field. Walk through the home, the beat never splits, the melody never breaks. Sync delay, auto calibration, 5-band EQ, lyric tuning run end-to-end across all group members. Any Ava controls another's real state. Groups of 3+ align each room separately. Older hardware approaches conservatively. Top Surround opens the stage, News broadcast brings speech forward — per-Ava EQ retained. Lyrics fully joined: Offset returns words to singer's entrance, Follow controls line movement. Local and remote tuned independently until sound, lyrics, space arrive together.

Path: Play music → fullscreen player → Open MA → Library/Up Next/Sync

✦ TTS Target Volume
Temporarily moves to set level while speaking, returns afterward. Volume key during reply only remembers return point. System and TTS volume side by side. Optional HA entity for night/day automation. Thanks @realroywalker.
Path: Settings → Voice Config → Voice replies → Audio

✦ No Separate Caretaker
Place all app icons, clear desktop icons, next-page overflow. Icon-size adjustment with live preview. Music, network, service, theme, HA sensors become widgets. Sidebar items reorderable and renamable. Restart & Exit shortcut added, second-tap protection. Pin to wall reduces accidental escapes. Crash self-healing returns to foreground, screen stall rescue, 20 incident logs. HA reconnection auto-recovers. Firmware 2026.09.1.

Path: Settings → Device Service → Show other app icons / Sidebar settings / Auto restart

✦ Fixes
MA lyrics in fullscreen player #deergitseason. Wake-word loss after dashboard touch #waveriderai. 30+ fixes: TTS timing, memory leaks, thread safety, Sendspin port recovery, playback reconnection, lyrics on old Android, square-screen player, desktop refresh, multi-device discovery, voice music search punctuation, return bar flicker.
